\ flagship phase D: write a transform of the data window INTO BLOCK 13 (paged data out), then UPDATE.
\ With tab[i]=i the transform is 2*i (mod 256), which phase E recomputes and compares byte for byte.
4 CONSTANT DATABLK
13 CONSTANT XFM
CREATE dw 0 , CREATE xw 0 , CREATE di 0 ,
: DATA ( -- addr ) dw @ ;
: XB ( -- addr ) xw @ ;
: RUND ( -- ) DATABLK BLOCK dw ! XFM BLOCK xw ! 0 di !
  BEGIN di @ 128 < WHILE
    di @ DATA + C@ 2 * di @ XB + C!
    di @ 1 + di ! REPEAT
  UPDATE SAVE DROP ;
RUND
